title: Rounded Down Ratings
description: average_rating(ratings) returns the average of a list of star ratings. Every average comes out as a whole number.
hint: Python has two division operators. What's the difference between `/` and `//`?
explanation: `//` is floor division: it throws away the fractional part. 4 and 5 stars average to 4.5, not 4. Use `/` for true division.
